risks.label: IRGC Targets US Companies — Effective April 1
risks.detail: Iran's IRGC announced they will target US companies in the Middle East region starting today. Direct escalation risk even as peace signals emerge. Oil and defense stocks in focus.

risks.label: Oil Supply Shock — Brent $110.69
risks.detail: Brent crude posted a record 64% monthly gain in March — the biggest since 1988. Strait of Hormuz crisis nearly shut 20% of global oil transit. Infrastructure damage will take months to repair even with ceasefire.

risks.label: Central Banks Reverse to Hawkish
risks.detail: Fed and BoE pausing rate cuts. ECB floating rate increases. Oil-driven inflation forcing the most significant monetary policy pivot since 2022. Growth stocks and duration assets at risk.

risks.label: ISM Prices Paid Rising — Inflation Signal
risks.detail: ISM Manufacturing Prices Paid expected at 73.8, up from 70.5. Input cost inflation accelerating. Stagflation risk elevated with weak ADP forecast (41K) and rising prices simultaneously.

events.label: ISM Manufacturing PMI + ADP Jobs + Retail Sales — April 1
events.detail: Triple macro release today: ADP Jobs (forecast 41K), Retail Sales (+0.5%), ISM PMI (52.3). Heaviest data day of Q2 opening. ISM Prices Paid is the inflation tell.

events.label: Liberation Day Anniversary — April 2
events.detail: One year since Trump's sweeping tariffs. Supreme Court ruled IEEPA tariffs unconstitutional in Feb 2026. Temporary 10% tariff under Trade Act of 1974 now in effect. Congressional review looming.

events.label: Nonfarm Payrolls — April 3
events.detail: Friday's NFP will be the week's main event. ADP today serves as a preview. The labor market is the last pillar supporting the consumer — any crack here changes the narrative.

events.label: EIA Crude Oil Inventories — April 1
events.detail: Forecast -1.3M barrels vs +6.9M prior build. A large draw pushes oil higher. A build could provide temporary relief. Release at 9:30 AM ET.

events.label: Fed Vice Chair Barr Speaks — April 1
events.detail: Watch for rate path signals amid oil-driven inflation. Are rate cuts dead for 2026?

opportunities.label: Energy Sector — Oil Above $110
opportunities.detail: XOM, CVX, Shell, BP leading. Energy is the top-performing sector. Even with peace, oil won't return to pre-war $72 levels soon. Analyst 2026 Brent avg forecast: $82.85.

opportunities.label: ETH Breakout Attempt — $2,100 Retest
opportunities.detail: Ethereum outperforming BTC (+2.48% vs +1.09%). Higher beta play on risk-on shift. $2,000 support held through all March chaos. Targeting $2,300-$2,500 on continuation.

opportunities.label: Korean Tech Rebound — Samsung, SK Hynix
opportunities.detail: KOSPI circuit breaker at +5.5%. Samsung +10%, SK Hynix +9.5%. Export-heavy Korean tech is biggest beneficiary of reduced geopolitical risk. Possible multi-day catch-up rally.

opportunities.label: Airlines Short — Fuel Cost Squeeze
opportunities.detail: Only declining sector in the rally. AAL -1.8%, DAL -1.5%, Ryanair -2.3%. Brent above $110 is catastrophic for margins. Even with ceasefire, oil stays elevated for quarters.

regime_items.label: Transitional Regime — VIX Collapse
regime_items.detail: VIX crashed from 30.6 to 16.2 (-47%) in days. Market shifting from pure risk-off to transitional. Equity momentum strong but institutional flows still cautious. Fear & Greed at 32 (improving from 18).

regime_items.label: S&P 500 Breaks 5,800 Resistance
regime_items.detail: S&P broke above 200-day SMA at 5,800 on March 31's rally. Breadth excellent (420/500 advancing). Confirmation needs follow-through this week.

regime_items.label: Gold's Worst Month Since 2008
regime_items.detail: Gold crashed -14% in March after ATH of $4,891. Rising rates, stronger dollar, and oil-driven inflation eroding safe-haven bid. Now at $4,525 — still elevated YTD.

regime_items.label: Record Oil Monthly Gain
regime_items.detail: Brent +64% in March — biggest monthly gain since records began in 1988. The commodity supershock is reshaping monetary policy, trade flows, and sector rotation globally.
